sentences.en: The children were excited.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们是兴奋的。

sentences.en: They were going to take part in a play.
sentences.zh: 他们是去到拿部分在……里一个玩。

sentences.en: It was all about the history of the town.
sentences.zh: 它是全部关于这历史学的这城镇。

sentences.en: The play was going to be held in the park, and the children had to rehearse their scene.
sentences.zh: 这玩是去到是拿着在……里这公园， 和这孩子们有到排练他们的场景。

sentences.en: "I hope we don't forget what to do," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 我希望我们不忘记什么到做， 说 Chip。 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: Gran had come to watch the rehearsal.
sentences.zh: Gran 有来到手表这排练。

sentences.en: "My goodness!" She said.
sentences.zh: 我的美德！ 她说。

sentences.en: "I don't believe it!
sentences.zh: 我不相信它！

sentences.en: Biff is wearing a dress!"
sentences.zh: Biff 是穿一个连衣裙！

sentences.en: "That's because we're children from World War II," "Girls didn't wear trousers then." Said Chip.
sentences.zh: 那是因为我们是孩子们从世界战争二， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "Our town was bombed in the war," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 我们的城镇是烂醉的在……里这战争， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "The bombing was called the Blitz."
sentences.zh: 这轰炸是叫这闪电战。

sentences.en: Gran could remember it.
sentences.zh: Gran 能记得它。

sentences.en: "I was only a girl," She said.
sentences.zh: 它不是一个男孩； 它是一个女孩！ Biff， 他说。

sentences.en: "But I remember the Blitz well."
sentences.zh: 我是只有一个女孩， 她说， 但是我记得这闪电战好。

sentences.en: "You wore awful clothes like these?" Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 你穿坏的衣服喜欢这些？ 说 Biff。 哇！

sentences.en: "We have to carry these boxes," Said Wilma.
sentences.zh: 我们有到搬运这些盒子， 说 Wilma。 所以是我们， 说 Wilma。

sentences.en: "But they are empty."
sentences.zh: 但是他们是空的。

sentences.en: "They weren't empty in the war," said Gran.
sentences.zh: 他们不是空的在……里这战争， 说 Gran。 哦不！ 说 Gran。

sentences.en: "They had gas masks in them.
sentences.zh: 他们有气体面罩在……里他们。

sentences.en: We had to take them to school every day." "Gas masks?" Gasped Wilf.
sentences.zh: 我们有到拿他们到学校每个一天。 气体面罩？ 喘气 Wilf。 哦！ 喘气 Biff。

sentences.en: "Fantastic!"
sentences.zh: 非常棒的！

sentences.en: The children rehearsed their parts.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们排练他们的部分。

sentences.en: In the play, they were sent away to live in the country.
sentences.zh: 在……里这玩， 他们是发送离开到住在……里这国家。

sentences.en: It wasn't safe to stay in the town because of the bombing.
sentences.zh: 它不是安全的到停留在……里这城镇因为的这轰炸。

sentences.en: "We have to pretend to be upset," said Wilma.
sentences.zh: 我们有到假装到是使苦恼， 说 Wilma。 所以是我们， 说 Wilma。

sentences.en: Chip tried to pull a sad face.
sentences.zh: Chip 经过考验的到拉一个伤心的脸。

sentences.en: "I'm going to pretend to cry," Said Wilf.
sentences.zh: T'm 去到假装到哭， 说 Wilf。 哦不！ 说 Wilf。

sentences.en: He made a loud noise blowing his nose.
sentences.zh: 他做一个大声的噪音吹他的鼻子。

sentences.en: "Stop it," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 停它， 说 Biff。 哇！

sentences.en: "You're making me laugh."
sentences.zh: 你是做我笑。

sentences.en: The others began to laugh too.
sentences.zh: 这其他开始到笑也。

sentences.en: "We shouldn't laugh," said Wilma.
sentences.zh: 我们不应该笑， 说 Wilma。 所以是我们， 说 Wilma。

sentences.en: Gran spoke to the children.
sentences.zh: Gran 说到这孩子们。

sentences.en: "The war was a terrible time for everyone," she said.
sentences.zh: 这战争是一个可怕的时间为了每个人， 她说。

sentences.en: "It wasn't funny."
sentences.zh: 它不是有趣的。

sentences.en: "We're sorry, Gran," said Chip.
sentences.zh: Gran！ 说 Chip。 咳！

sentences.en: "But it was a long time ago."
sentences.zh: 但是它是一个长的时间以前。

sentences.en: After the rehearsal, Wilf and Wilma went home with Biff and Chip.
sentences.zh: 在……之后这排练， Wilf 和 Wilma 去家和……一起 Biff 和 Chip。

sentences.en: Chip thought about the war.
sentences.zh: Chip 想关于这战争。

sentences.en: "It must have been a hard time for children then," he said.
sentences.zh: 它必须有是一个困难的时间为了孩子们然后， 他说。

sentences.en: He said.
sentences.zh: Biff， 他说。

sentences.en: "It's hard to imagine what it was like," said Wilf.
sentences.zh: 它是困难的到想象什么它是喜欢， 说 Wilf。 哦不！ 说 Wilf。

sentences.en: "I can't wait to take these clothes off," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我不能等到拿这些衣服离开， 说 Biff。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "I hate wearing this dress."
sentences.zh: 我憎恶穿这个连衣裙。

sentences.en: Suddenly the magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 突然地这魔法钥匙开始到光亮。

sentences.en: The magic took the children off on another adventure.
sentences.zh: 这魔法拿这孩子们离开在……上另一个冒险。

sentences.en: It took them back to a street in London.
sentences.zh: 它拿他们回来到一个街道在……里伦敦。

sentences.en: "We've come back to the war," Gasped Chip.
sentences.zh: 我们有来回来到解救 Floppy。 Gran！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "This looks like the scene in our play."
sentences.zh: 这个看喜欢这场景在……里我们的玩他们看见一个小的男孩全部由他自己。

sentences.en: They saw a little boy all by himself.
sentences.zh: 他们看见一个小的男孩。

sentences.en: "I was with my school," Said the boy.
sentences.zh: 它是时间到去到学校。 不你知道？

sentences.en: "But I got lost.
May I come with you?"
sentences.zh: 我来和……一起你？

sentences.en: Suddenly there was a long wailing sound.
sentences.zh: 突然地那里是一个长的恸哭声音。

sentences.en: "That's an air raid warning," said Wilma.
sentences.zh: 那是一个空气突袭警告， 说 Wilma。 所以是我们， 说 Wilma。

sentences.en: "It means we're going to be bombed."
sentences.zh: 它意思是我们是去到是烂醉的。

sentences.en: People began to run.
sentences.zh: 人们开始到跑。

sentences.en: A man shouted at them.
sentences.zh: 一个男人喊在他们。

sentences.en: "Hey!" he yelled.
sentences.zh: 帮助！ 嗨！ 他叫喊。

sentences.en: "Get into the shelter!"
sentences.zh: 得到进入这庇护所！

sentences.en: Everyone went into the shelter.
sentences.zh: 每个人去进入这庇护所。

sentences.en: Above the shelter, bombs were landing.
sentences.zh: 在这庇护所， 炸弹是上岸。

sentences.en: Everything rocked and shook.
sentences.zh: 一切岩石和 shook。

sentences.en: "I'm scared," said the little boy.
"So are we," said Wilma.
sentences.zh: 所以是我们， 说 Wilma。

sentences.en: "I hope it's safe down here," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我希望它是安全的向下这里， 说 Biff。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: The noise went on for about twenty minutes.
sentences.zh: 这噪音去在……上为了关于二十分。

sentences.en: Then it stopped.
sentences.zh: 然后它停。

sentences.en: Everything was quiet for a little while.
sentences.zh: 一切是安静的为了一个小的当……的时候。

sentences.en: Then the loud wailing noise began.
sentences.zh: 然后这大声的恸哭噪音开始。

sentences.en: The air raid was over.
sentences.zh: 这空气突袭是在……上方。

sentences.en: "That was really frightening," said Wilf.
sentences.zh: 那个是真的骇人的， 说 Wilf。 哦不！ 说 Wilf。

sentences.en: The children came out of the shelter.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们来出的这庇护所。

sentences.en: They couldn't believe their eyes.
sentences.zh: 他们不能相信他们的眼睛。

sentences.en: The street had been bombed.
sentences.zh: 这街道有是烂醉的。

sentences.en: There was smoke and dust everywhere.
sentences.zh: 那里是烟和灰尘到处。

sentences.en: Wilma put her arm round the little boy.
sentences.zh: Wilma 放她臂圆形的这小的男孩。

sentences.en: One building was gone.
sentences.zh: 一建造是去了。

sentences.en: It was just a pile of bricks.
sentences.zh: 它是刚刚一个堆的砖。

sentences.en: Another building was on fire.
sentences.zh: 另一个建造是在……上火。

sentences.en: Firemen were starting to put the fire out.
sentences.zh: 消防队员是开始到放这火出。

sentences.en: "This is terrible," said Wilf.
sentences.zh: 这个是可怕的， 说 Wilf。 哦不！ 说 Wilf。

sentences.en: "I didn't think it would be like this."
sentences.zh: 我没有想它会是喜欢这个。

sentences.en: A woman ran up to the children.
sentences.zh: 一个女人跑向上到这孩子们。

sentences.en: She took the little boy's hand.
sentences.zh: 她拿这小的男孩手。

sentences.en: "Oh, I'm so glad I found you," She said.
sentences.zh: 我是所以高兴的我有找到你， 他说。 Biff， 他说。

sentences.en: She looked at the others.
sentences.zh: 她看在这其他。

sentences.en: "You must all have got lost, too," she said.
sentences.zh: 你必须全部有得到丢失， 也， 她说。

sentences.en: The train will be leaving soon."
sentences.zh: 这火车将是离开很快。

sentences.en: The station was crowded with children.
sentences.zh: 这火车站是拥挤的和……一起孩子们。

sentences.en: They all had gas masks and they looked upset and unhappy.
sentences.zh: 他们全部有气体面罩和他们看使苦恼和痛苦的。

sentences.en: "We are being sent away," Said the little boy.
sentences.zh: 我们是正在发送离开， 说这小的男孩。

sentences.en: "It's because of the bombing.
sentences.zh: 它是因为的这轰炸。

sentences.en: It's too dangerous to live here."
sentences.zh: 它是也危险的到住这里。

sentences.en: A woman gave them all a brown paper bag.
sentences.zh: 一个女人给他们全部一个棕色的纸包。

sentences.en: Wilma looked inside hers.
sentences.zh: Wilma 看里面她的。

sentences.en: "It's a dry old sandwich and an apple," She said.
sentences.zh: 它是一个干的旧的三明治和一个苹果， 她说， 但是不含糖的或者巧克力长条。 Biff， 他说。

sentences.en: "But no sweets or chocolate bars." "Of course not," Said the woman.
sentences.zh: 我们没有有许多的含糖的或者巧克力。 的进程不， 说这女人。

sentences.en: "What did you expect?"
sentences.zh: 什么做你预计？

sentences.en: A man blew a whistle.
sentences.zh: 一个男人 blew 一个哨声。

sentences.en: "Gas masks on," He ordered.
sentences.zh: 气体面罩在……上， 他整齐的。

sentences.en: "And don't worry, there is no gas.
sentences.zh: 和不担心， 那里是不气体。

sentences.en: This is just a practice."
sentences.zh: 这个是刚刚一个实践。

sentences.en: "We don't have gas masks," whispered Chip.
sentences.zh: 我们不有气体面罩， 低语 Chip。 我不相信它！ 低语 Chip。

sentences.en: "We only have empty boxes."
sentences.zh: 我们只有有空的盒子。

sentences.en: Wilf opened his box.
sentences.zh: Wilf 打开他的盒子。

sentences.en: Inside it was a gas mask.
sentences.zh: 里面它是一个气体面罩。

sentences.en: They all had gas masks in their boxes.
sentences.zh: 他们全部有气体面罩在……里他们的盒子。

sentences.en: "I can't believe it!" He gasped.
sentences.zh: 我不相信它！ 哦！ 喘气 Biff。

sentences.en: "Hurry up!"
sentences.zh: 急忙向上！

sentences.en: Shouted the man crossly.
sentences.zh: 急忙向上！ 喊这男人生气地。

sentences.en: "You must put them on quickly."
sentences.zh: 你必须放他们在……上快速地。

sentences.en: Biff hated wearing the gas mask.
sentences.zh: Biff 帽子穿这气体面罩。

sentences.en: It felt tight and uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 它感觉紧的和不舒服的。

sentences.en: It had a funny smell and it felt hot.
sentences.zh: 它有一个有趣的气味和它感觉热的。

sentences.en: When she talked, her voice sounded funny and the gas mask steamed up.
sentences.zh: 当……时她谈话， 她说话声声音有趣的和这气体面罩蒸煮的向上。

sentences.en: She couldn't wait to take it off.
sentences.zh: 她不能等到拿它离开。

sentences.en: "Ugh," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "That was terrible.
sentences.zh: 那个是可怕的。

sentences.en: It was so hard to breathe in that gas mask."
sentences.zh: 它是所以困难的到呼吸在……里那个气体面罩。

sentences.en: The man blew his whistle again.
sentences.zh: 这男人 blew 他的哨声再一次。

sentences.en: It was time to get on the train.
sentences.zh: 它是时间到得到在……上这火车。

sentences.en: All the children had to line up.
sentences.zh: 全部这孩子们有到线向上。

sentences.en: The little boy began to cry.
sentences.zh: 这小的男孩开始到哭。

sentences.en: "I don't want to go away," Sniffed the boy.
sentences.zh: 我不想要到看！ 我不想要到去离开， 吸气这男孩。

sentences.en: "I don't even know where we are going."
sentences.zh: 我不竟然知道哪里我们是去。

sentences.en: "But it's not safe to stay," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 但是它是不安全的到停留， 说 Chip。 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "My mum has to stay," said the boy.
sentences.zh: 我的妈妈有到停留， 说这男孩。 不你知道？

sentences.en: Wilma gave the boy a packet of tissues.
sentences.zh: Wilma 给这男孩一个盒的组织。

sentences.en: "I've never seen tissues before," said the boy.
sentences.zh: 我已经从不看见组织在……之前， 说这男孩。 不你知道？

sentences.en: At last the train came in.
sentences.zh: 在最后的这火车来在……里。

sentences.en: "It's a steam engine," said Wilf.
sentences.zh: 它是一个水蒸气发动机， 说 Wilf。 哦不！ 说 Wilf。

sentences.en: The train puffed out smoke and it made a clanking noise.
sentences.zh: 这火车肿胀的出烟和它做一个当啷声噪音。

sentences.en: As it stopped, it gave a loud hiss.
sentences.zh: 像它停， 它给一个大声的他的。

sentences.en: Smoke and steam filled the air.
sentences.zh: 烟和水蒸气充满这空气。

sentences.en: The grown-up began to call the children's names out.
sentences.zh: 这成熟的开始到叫这孩子们名字出。

sentences.en: Then they were told to get on the train.
sentences.zh: 然后他们是告诉到得到在……上这火车。

sentences.en: "I don't think our names are going to be called out," said Wilma.
sentences.zh: 我不想我们的名字是去到是叫出， 说 Wilma。 所以是我们， 说 Wilma。

sentences.en: "They don't know who we are."
sentences.zh: 他们不知道谁我们是。

sentences.en: Wilma was right.
sentences.zh: Wilma 是正确的。

sentences.en: The man came across to them.
sentences.zh: 这男人来穿过到他们。

sentences.en: "Why aren't you on the train?" He asked.
sentences.zh: 为什么不是你在……上这火车？ 他问。 他追赶它！

sentences.en: The woman looked at her list.
sentences.zh: 这女人看在她名单。

sentences.en: "There shouldn't be anyone left," she said.
sentences.zh: 那里不应该是任何人离开， 她说。

sentences.en: "I don't know who these children are."
sentences.zh: 我不知道谁这些孩子们是。

sentences.en: "We can't leave them behind," said the man.
sentences.zh: 我们不能离开他们在……后面， 说这男人。

sentences.en: "I'm sorry," said the man.
sentences.zh: 我是对不起， 说这男人。

sentences.en: "We can find out who they are later.
sentences.zh: 我们能找到出谁他们是后来。

sentences.en: But we'll have to split them up."
sentences.zh: 但是我们会有到切开他们向上。

sentences.en: "We don't want to be split up," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我们不想要到是切开向上， 说 Biff。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "We want to stay together." "I'm sorry," said the man.
sentences.zh: 我们想要到停留一起。 我是对不起， 说这男人。

sentences.en: "I don't think you can."
sentences.zh: 我不想你能。

sentences.en: "We can't always keep children together," Said the woman.
sentences.zh: 我们不能总是保持孩子们一起， 说这女人。 的进程不， 说这女人。

sentences.en: "Not even brothers and sisters." "That's terrible," Said Chip.
sentences.zh: 不竟然弟弟和姐姐。 那个是可怕的。 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: Suddenly the magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 突然地这魔法钥匙开始到光亮。

sentences.en: The adventure was over.
sentences.zh: 这冒险是在……上方。

sentences.en: "I didn't like that adventure," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 我没有喜欢那个冒险， 说 Chip。 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "I was so scared being in that air raid."
sentences.zh: 我是所以惊恐的正在在……里那个空气突袭。

sentences.en: "I felt sorry for the children," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我感觉对不起为了这孩子们， 说 Biff。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "Imagine having to leave home and going to live with people you don't know."
sentences.zh: 想象有到离开家和去到住和……一起人们你不知道。

sentences.en: "That poor little boy!" Said Wilma.
sentences.zh: 那个贫穷的小的男孩！ 说 Wilma。 所以是我们， 说 Wilma。

sentences.en: Chip asked Gran to tell them about the war.
sentences.zh: Chip 问 Gran 到告诉他们关于这战争。

sentences.en: "I never saw a banana," said Gran.
sentences.zh: 我从不看见一个香蕉， 说 Gran。 哦不！ 说 Gran。

sentences.en: "There wasn't much food.
sentences.zh: 那里不是许多食物。

sentences.en: We didn't have lots of sweets or chocolate.
sentences.zh: 我们没有有许多的含糖的或者巧克力。

sentences.en: We didn't have nice soap and shampoo.
sentences.zh: 我们没有有好的肥皂和洗发剂。

sentences.en: We only had a bath once a week."
sentences.zh: 我们只有有一个洗澡一次一个星期。

sentences.en: It was the night of the play.
sentences.zh: 它是这夜晚的这玩。

sentences.en: Biff, Chip, Wilf and Wilma didn't laugh when they played their parts.
sentences.zh: Biff， Chip， Wilf 和 Wilma 没有笑当……时他们玩他们的部分。

sentences.en: They remembered the magic adventure.
sentences.zh: 他们记得这魔法冒险。

sentences.en: They thought of the children waiting for the train to come in.
sentences.zh: 他们想的这孩子们等为了这火车到来在……里。

sentences.en: Gran was pleased with them.
sentences.zh: Gran 是请和……一起他们。

sentences.en: "You were really good," she said.
sentences.zh: 你是真的好的， 她说。

sentences.en: Biff told Gran a secret.
sentences.zh: Biff 告诉 Gran 一个秘密。

sentences.en: "The magic key showed us how hard it was in the war," she said.
sentences.zh: 这魔法钥匙展示我们如何困难的它是在……里这战争， 她说。

sentences.en: "I'm glad we only had to act it."
sentences.zh: 我是高兴的我们只有有到行为它。
